PGDeviceDescriptor.doc: A description of the paravirtualized graphics device to create.

PGDisplayDescriptor.doc: A descriptor for a virtual display.

PGDisplayMode.doc: A description of a supported display mode.

PGDisplay.doc: An object that provides display functionality to the guest operating system in a way that the host-side virtual machine app can intercept.

PGResumeErrorCodeIncompatibleDevice.doc: The resume device is missing capabilities that the suspended device provided.

PGResumeErrorCodeInvalidContent.doc: The content of the suspend state or the guest memory isn’t valid.

PGResumeErrorCodeInvalidGuestVersion.doc: The guest version is incompatible with this framework version.

PGResumeErrorCodeInvalidSuspendStateVers.doc: The suspend state version is incompatible with this framework version.

PGDisplayCoord_t.doc: Coordinates that describe sizes or offsets within a 2D array of pixels.

PGPhysicalMemoryRange_s.doc: A range in the guest virtual machine’s physical memory address space.

addTraceRange.doc: A handler that the framework calls to add a trace range.

createTask.doc: A handler that the framework calls to create a task object.

destroyTask.doc: A handler that the framework calls to destroy a task object.

device.doc: The Metal device object to use to back the virtual graphics device.

mapMemory.doc: A handler that the framework calls to map memory into the virtual machine.

mmioLength.doc: The length in bytes of the memory-mapped IO section.

raiseInterrupt.doc: A handler that the system calls to raise an interrupt in the guest environment.

readMemory.doc: A handler that the framework calls to read data from the guest’s memory.

removeTraceRange.doc: A handler that the framework calls to remove a trace range.

unmapMemory.doc: A handler that the framework calls to unmap memory from the virtual machine.

cursorGlyphHandler.doc: A handler that the framework calls to change the cursor’s appearance.

cursorShowHandler.doc: A handler that the framework calls to change the cursor’s visibility.

modeChangeHandler.doc: A handler that the framework calls to change the virtual display’s graphics mode.

name.doc: The display’s name as seen in the guest operating environment.

newFrameEventHandler.doc: A handler that the framework calls when the guest environment has a new frame to display.

queue.doc: The queue that the framework uses when dispatching messages to any of the display’s registered handlers.

sizeInMillimeters.doc: The size in millimeters of the virtual display.

sizeInPixels.doc: The display mode’s dimensions in pixels.
